annotations.title: Annotation
annotations.addHint: Press A to add an annotation at the cursor, or Ctrl+click on the chart.
annotations.timeInvalid: Enter a valid time; the end must not be before the start.
annotations.changed: Someone changed this annotation in the meantime. The dialog now shows what is stored; save again to change it.
annotations.fromQuery: This annotation comes from an annotation query of the dashboard and is changed in its data source.
annotations.queries.title: Annotation queries
annotations.queries.hint: Each row of the result becomes an annotation on every time panel: the first time column is the time, a column named timeEnd ends a span, text (or the first text column) is the text and tags are the tags.
annotations.queries.shapeHint: The query must answer a table with a time column.
annotations.queries.name: Name
annotations.queries.incomplete: Every annotation query needs a name and a data source.
